US Imposes Tariffs on Some Canadian Goods, Lifts Others

The United States has implemented new tariffs of 50% on a limited selection of Canadian goods. Concurrently, tariffs on certain other Canadian products have been removed. The specific goods affected by the new tariffs and those seeing removals were not detailed in the provided coverage. This action represents a shift in trade policy between the two North American nations.
